assessment_method: AI-assisted full-private-text context check; not independent human ground truth; stratified diagnostics do not estimate accuracy or prevalence
conclusion: Narrow exclusions have plausible selected examples, but residual ambiguity and missed concepts remain material. v1 is retained unchanged as diagnostics only. Concern prevalence, aspect sentiment and theme change remain unavailable. Any further rules require v2 and a new untouched holdout.
